TroopDamage.Hint: The description and rules update automatically when settings change. Manual text before the generated block is preserved.

TroopDamage.VariableIntro: The troop makes a coordinated attack against enemies in a {template} with a {check}.
TroopDamage.FixedIntro: The troop makes coordinated ranged strikes in a {burst} within {range} feet, dealing the damage below with a {check}. When the troop is reduced to 2 segments, its area of fire shrinks to a {small}.

TroopDamage.FixedIntroArea: The troop makes coordinated strikes against creatures in an {area}, dealing the damage below with a {check}. When the troop is reduced to 2 segments, the area shrinks to a {small}.
TroopDamage.VariableEnding: Damage depends on the number of actions spent and the number of troop segments, while its type depends on the selection at the top of the character sheet.
TroopDamage.FixedEnding: Damage depends on the number of troop segments, while its type depends on the selection at the top of the character sheet.
